title: Enterprise AI factory pilot on the Cisco and NVIDIA reference architecture
titleEn: Enterprise AI factory pilot on the Cisco and NVIDIA reference architecture
fidelityNote: The architecture facts are Cisco newsroom statements from February, March, and June 2025. The cost and schedule are planning bands for a small enterprise pilot pod. They are not a quote and not a hyperscale build.
executiveSummary: Cisco and NVIDIA published a Secure AI Factory pattern that ties UCS AI, Hyperfabric AI, Silicon One, Spectrum-X, certified storage, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise. Later public notes place AI Defense and Hypershield in the validated design. A PM uses the publications to freeze one pod: GPU count, rack, storage partner, and NOS. The first success is one fine-tune or one inference job, plus a security observation report. A full factory is out of scope.
problemStatement: Training and inference split across a front-end network, a back-end network, GPU-to-GPU traffic, storage, and security. Buying those separately produces two operating models. Some organizations cannot put the data in a public cloud. A prototype then has no path to production.
opportunity: The February 2025 partnership note says Silicon One is the only partner silicon planned for Spectrum-X Ethernet. The March 2025 Secure AI Factory announcement bundles the compute, fabric, storage, and software. The June 2025 note includes AI Defense and Hypershield in the NVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory validated design.
strategicAlignment: Size the pod to one validation job. Power, export control, and a security observation mode come before the purchase order.
businessValue: The sponsor has a signed scale card and one finished job on that pod. Roadmap features that cannot be ordered today are not success criteria.
architecturePattern: UCS AI servers, a Silicon One and Hyperfabric AI Ethernet fabric with optional Spectrum-X, certified storage, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, and security observation through AI Defense and Hypershield. Front-end and back-end networks share one operating model.
planningBandNote: Price moves with GPU count. The band below is a small enterprise pilot pod, not a quote.

narrative.heading: What Cisco published with NVIDIA
narrative.body:
In February 2025 Cisco said it was expanding the NVIDIA partnership and described Silicon One as the only partner silicon planned for Spectrum-X Ethernet. In March 2025 the Secure AI Factory announcement bundled Cisco UCS AI, Hyperfabric AI, Silicon One, Spectrum-X, certified storage, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise. In June 2025 the AI-ready data center note included AI Defense and Hypershield in the NVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory validated design.

Those are architecture facts. They do not include a customer's GPU count, a power bill, or a training-time result. This record therefore keeps the facts in the outcomes and puts the pod size in a planning band.

narrative.heading: The pilot cut
narrative.body: Write the scale card. Check export control and power. Order only what is on the card. Run one job. Watch it in observation mode. A second charter is required before anyone calls the result a factory.
